episodes.title: God or Devil!? The Mightiest Man Appears in Hell.
episodes.summary: It is the year 199X and nuclear war has ravaged the world. Society has collapsed, leaving the weak to fight for their lives while the strong take what they please. The Zeed gang is looting villages and killing anyone that they find, not even women and children are safe. But, from the wasteland a mysterious stranger appears, to protect those that cannot protect themselves.
